session_note: Indiana's 2026 session was the short (even-year) regular session of the 124th General Assembly, constitutionally required to adjourn by 2026-03-15, and it in fact adjourned sine die on 2026-02-27 (confirmed via Indiana Capital Chronicle and WFYI live session coverage); bills not enacted by that sine die are dead for the year and must be reintroduced with new bill numbers in a future session rather than carrying over, consistent with Indiana Capital Chronicle's own framing of unpassed bills needing lawmakers to 'try again next year.' Note: iga.in.gov's own bill-status pages could not be rendered at any point during this research pass (every path on the domain returned an identical ~691-byte unrendered SPA shell with an 'x-cache: Error from cloudfront' header, indicating a site-wide CloudFront/origin outage rather than normal routing), so dispositions below rely on the Governor's official 2026 Bill Watch (in.gov), Indiana Capital Chronicle, WFYI, IndyStar, and the Citizens Action Coalition's bill tracker rather than the gold-standard legislature_bill_page source type.

new_bills.key_provisions: Water Intensive Facilities: would have authorized Indiana to deny economic incentives to data centers and other large industrial water users unless facilities met specified requirements, including a utility's ability to provide adequate water and the facility paying associated infrastructure costs.
